title: Cascade token system for responsive spacing, color anchors, and layered elevation
creator: Lena Chen
description:
Summary: Replace the disparate spacing/ radius/ color/ elevation tokens with a cascade-first token set that maps 'springs' (spacing deltas), color anchors (semantic + tone ramps), and layered elevation steps. Goal is to reduce token variance across buttons, tables and chart components, simplify runtime token calculations for responsive layouts, and produce a clear migration path for component library and Storybook.

Scope:
- New token spec: spacing.springs.* (xs, sm, md, lg mapped to responsive min/target/max), radius.spring.* for corner interpolation, color.anchor.* (neutral/accent/critical with 7-tone ramps), elevation.layer.* (0..6) with physicalized shadow recipes.
- Update button, table row, and chart panel components to consume new tokens.
- Export token packages (tokens/json, tokens/scss, tokens/ts) and update design-system package version.
- Deliver Figma library, handoff docs, and migration guide for frontend.

Out of scope: component redesign, cross-platform native SDKs (handled in a follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Token spec doc published in Confluence with examples and runtime mapping
Figma library updated and published with token aliases and examples for buttons, table rows, and charts
Design-system package published at v3.12.0 with tokens JSON and SCSS outputs
Storybook stories for Button/Table/Chart demonstrate old vs new tokens and pass visual diff review
Migration guide and codemods available for frontend teams; at least one consumer app migrated in pilot
Performance: token resolution cost on critical path reduced or equivalent; no measurable latency regressions in console routes
comments: 2026-02-12 Lena Chen: Created ticket — initial audit shows ~78 color tokens, 12 radius variants, and 23 elevation shadow permutations across components. Proposal: compress to 28 canonical tokens with clear mapping rules.

2026-02-20 Asha Patel: Prototype of spacing.springs published in Figma; added responsive min/target/max and examples for compact/dense modes. Requested sign-off from accessibility team for minimum tappable areas.

2026-02-27 Miguel Torres: Engineering review — kernel runtime expects token lookups <1µs; we'll provide precompiled JSON and a small runtime shim. ENG will provide CI checks to fail on removed token usage.
2026-03-03 Priya Desai: Accessibility review — contrast report added for anchor tone ramps; suggested increasing neutral-anchor-1 lightness by 2% for WCAG AA on small text.
2026-03-06 Asha Patel: Updated Figma with corrected neutral-anchor-1; created illustrative matrix for Button states (default/hover/pressed/disabled) mapped to tokens.
2026-03-08 Omar Khan: QA note — visual diffs for table row hover show slight shadow offset; adjusted elevation.layer.2 shadow Y offset from 4px to 3px to match existing motion language.
2026-03-10 Lena Chen: Merged tokens into design-system main branch; draft migration codemod PR opened (#487). Planning pilot migration for analytics dashboard next week.
notes: Design trade-offs: We favor fewer semantic anchors with tone ramps to avoid per-component token proliferation. Some legacy components will need temporary aliases until migrations complete.
Technical constraint: Electron-based consumer app requires SCSS output; ensure tokens/scss contains flattened maps for compile-time theming.
Rollout plan: 1) Publish tokens and Figma, 2) Update design-system package and Storybook, 3) Pilot migrate one consumer app, 4) Broad migration with codemods and deprecation notices over 6 weeks.
Follow-ups: schedule a cross-team sync with platform infra to add CI token-linting; create ENG- follow-up tickets for codemod fixes and runtime shim adoption.
